error_control.gamma: 6/(pi^2 j^2), j = position of the confirmatory hypothesis in this registry
error_control.scope: Applies to every confirmatory hypothesis registered after 2026-10-13; order fixed by registration time

equivalence_policy.rule: Any claim of equivalence or non-inferiority requires a margin in percentage points registered before the data and a TOST or non-inferiority test (tost_paired / noninferiority_paired); a non-significant difference never establishes equivalence (Schuirmann 1987; Lakens 2017)
equivalence_policy.check: No statement in docs/research/claims_ledger.json asserts equivalence; limits state the opposite where relevant

hypotheses.decision_rule: five primary pairs; mean NeuroPixel binding >= 0.90, mean paired advantage >= 0.05 and two-sided t95 lower bound > 0
hypotheses.alpha_source: own protocol; outside the online stream
hypotheses.evidence_level: L0 blocked_external (raw archive unavailable; see A18.2.H.ext)

exploratory_note: These studies used exploratory, unadjusted intervals; they spend no alpha and support no confirmatory claim
